tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand: the navy of the logo's wordmark. All headings, body text and figures. 14.98:1 on page, 16.1:1 on surface, 14.0:1 or more on every tint. Never a status.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Brand action: the logo's sky blue taken deeper. Fill of the one primary button (white text 5.72:1), the active key on the key bar, the focus ring (5.32:1 on page, 5.72:1 on surface) and links. Never a status.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed (white text 8.07:1).

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Selection ground: the selected list or table row, a focused field's fill. Interaction only, never a status. Navy on it 14.33:1.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The page: a very light blue-grey behind every card. Navy 14.98:1, ink-2 6.54:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, tables, lists, fields, dialogs and the key bar. Separated from page by shadow-card, not a border.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: key chips, neutral badges, skeleton bars, table headers, disabled fields, row hover.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, meta lines, helper text, table headers, quiet buttons, placeholders. 6.54:1 on page, 7.03:1 on surface, 6.12:1 or more on every tint.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Resting edge of fields, selects and secondary buttons: 3.26:1 on page, 3.51:1 on surface (the 3:1 control floor).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside tables and lists only — between rows. 1.23:1 on surface: it separates, it never bounds a control or a card.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Done: synced, received, settled, day closed. Text and mark. 5.31:1 on surface, 4.94:1 on page, 4.69:1 on green-50. Status only, never brand.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Done ground: done badge and banner.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Needs attention — the mark: dots, triangles, banner rules. 3.64:1 on surface, 3.39:1 on page: marks only (3:1), never text.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Needs attention — the words: badge text, the lead word of a banner, attention figures on tiles. 5.91:1 on surface, 5.5:1 on page, 5.41:1 on amber-50.

tokens.name: amber-50
tokens.usage: Needs attention ground: attention badge and banner.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Refused: expired stock, a commit that cannot go through, a failed load. Text and mark. 6.0:1 on surface, 5.58:1 on page, 5.22:1 on red-50. Never decoration.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: Refused ground: refused badge and banner.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop: navy at 40%.

styles.name: change
styles.usage: Change due on the payment overlay. Tabular, navy (amber-text when short).

styles.name: total
styles.usage: The sale total and large balances. Tabular, navy.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and dialog titles in navy.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Body base and every control: buttons, fields, list rows.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Helper and secondary lines, banners; the cart and tables on tablet and phone.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Tables and the cart on laptop and desktop. Figures right-aligned, tabular.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and tile labels: sentence case, no tracking, ink-2, one line in a fixed label-height.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: The key name on the key bar and in hints (F2, Esc).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a label/value stack.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Label to field; key to its word on a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between adjacent controls (keeps 44px targets apart).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell and field side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between tiles and cards; tile padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and tile padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen gutter at laptop and up.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Cart and table rows on laptop and desktop (screen ≥1024px).

tokens.name: row-height-touch
tokens.usage: Cart and table rows on tablet and phone (screen <1024px), with body-sm text.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything actionable, key chips included.

tokens.name: label-height
tokens.usage: Fixed height of a tile or field label: one line, never wraps.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, selects, key chips.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, tables, lists, banners set inside a screen.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, tables, lists and the key bar: white on page, lifted by this instead of an outline.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: An interactive card or tile under the pointer.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The search dropdown.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.
